notes: DISCOVERED during the pending-home-sales-2026-09-17 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-08, D-9), in the same primary NAR fetch that promoted that event to `confirmed`. The gap it fills: NAR's 2026 schedule carries four quarterly Metro Home Prices releases (02-04, 05-05, 08-04, 10-29) and this calendar tracks none of them, so the only NAR housing series with a price rather than a volume reading is entirely absent. Proposed for the one remaining 2026 edition rather than backfilling the three that have passed. Impact `low` and `symbols: []` on the same measured basis as the two sibling PHSI ledgers: no house playbook is macro- or housing-keyed, no instrument attaches, and the 12-17 lane measured the print's own 10:00-11:00 hour indistinguishable from an ordinary hour on ITB (33.9% vs 35.3% of session range, p=0.79), XHB and SPY. Nothing here licenses an entry; an estimate widens caution rather than triggering action.
